transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we're here to discuss the possible sanctions-screening control failure affecting export shipments through our overseas distributor. Before we proceed, I want to make sure we follow the legal-incident process correctly. I'd like to hear from sanctions counsel, trade compliance, and the corporate secretary in that order, so I can review the full picture before approving any response package. Let's start with sanctions counsel's report.

transcript.text: I need to share an important update. I reviewed the distributor's transaction records and confirmed that exactly 7 shipments reached a restricted intermediary. This makes a voluntary disclosure to the relevant sanctions authority necessary. I had not circulated the count earlier because reconciliation of the source records was completed only this morning.
